confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from automated SQL injection attempts to a successful account takeover, privilege escalation, massive database querying, and subsequent data exfiltration via DNS tunneling and HTTPS, followed by an attempt to cover tracks by deleting logs.

attack_chain.description: Automated SQL injection attempts using sqlmap from IP 162.247.74.27.
Successful login of user_04 from the same malicious IP (162.247.74.27), which is outside their normal IP range and working hours.
Unauthorized privilege escalation where user_04 was elevated to 'dba' status.
Massive database queries targeting the 'customers' table, returning hundreds of thousands of rows.
Data exfiltration via DNS tunneling (UDP port 53) to a known malicious domain 'x3460.malicious-77.com'.
Large volume data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP port 443) to an external destination.
Attempt to cover tracks by deleting the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log).

gaps: The specific destination IP for the HTTPS exfiltration (evt_s90_038-042) is not explicitly listed in the metadata, only the port.
Confirmation of whether the SQL injection (evt_s90_001-003) was the direct mechanism used to obtain user_04's credentials.
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection to likely compromise user_04's credentials, then logged in from a malicious IP to escalate privileges to DBA. After querying massive amounts of customer data, the attacker exfiltrated the data via DNS and HTTPS before deleting system logs to hide their activity.
